text:
Marta V: Kicking off a thread because we're seeing delayed responses and a rise in 504s on /v1/stream from 11:08 UTC. Auto-alert fired. Im primary for this window.
OpsBot: [ALERT] 11:09 UTC  service latency on /v1/stream p95 > 2.5s and 5xx rate 3.7%. Incident score 58. Recent event: routing-config-update applied at 11:02 UTC. Link: https://internal.redwood/ops/1765499999
Ethan L: I'm secondary. Quick checks: autoscaler is healthy but pod readiness toggling. Metrics show one AZ with much higher qps (hot shard). Could be routing imbalance after the config change.
Priya S: Looking at controller logs: sticky-routing flag was enabled but not propagated to all gateways - some gateways still round-robin. That explains hotspot. Runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/routing-hotshard
Nate R: Paging rules reminder: page primary first (30s), if no ack page secondary (5 min), if infra/hardware suspected page infra-oncall immediately. For customer-impacting P1s, page CS and AMs within 10m.
Marta V: I see the diff from deploy:
```
- route-policy: round_robin
+ route-policy: sticky_by_customer
```
That went out 11:02. Rolling back might rebalance but sticky was intended for long-tail latency. Suggest two-step: revert routing change, then reapply with gateway config sync.
OpsBot: [AUTOMATION] Collected diagnostics: gateway-3 had 4k active connections, gateway-1 had 180. Redis connection pool at 95% on gateway-3. "hot_shard_detected": true.
Ethan L: Command to check gateway connections:
```
ssh gateway-3
redis-cli --csv client list | wc -l
```
Also check per-route qps:
```
curl -s 'https://metrics.internal/api?expr=topk(5, sum by(gateway)(rate(http_requests_total{route="/v1/stream"}[1m])))'
```
Priya S: Initiating temporary mitigations: increase gateway-3 pool limit + enable overflow routing to warm gateways. Doing a gradual throttle on sticky routing until all gateways have config. ETA 4m.
Marta V: Noted. I'll send short customer status if latency persists after 10m. Which accounts are impacted? OpsBot: list top affected customers.
OpsBot: [DATA] Top impacted customers: acme-corp (0.9% of total calls but 12% of errors), beta-inc (8% errors), internal-ci (test traffic causing long contexts). Tickets created: #INC-8890, #INC-8891.
Nate R: If acme-corp hits >10% error rate escalate to AM and CS lead immediately. Use the "incident-comm" template and include ETA for next update.
Ethan L: After pool bump and overflow routing, p95 improved from 2.8s -> 1.6s in 2m. 5xxs reduced to 1.1%. Keeping mitigations for 20m to ensure stability.
Priya S: Rolling back routing change at 11:18 as pre-emptive step to rebalance traffic. Patch applied and propagating.
Marta V: Rollback confirmed at 11:21. Observed more even gateway distribution. However, we still have residual connection churn from long-lived streams. Suggest adding a short-term rate-limit on internal-ci to prevent test job spikes.
Ethan L: Applying rate-limit on internal-ci via feature-gate. Command:
```
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://admin.internal/api/feature-gates -d '{"customer":"internal-ci","limits":{"concurrent_streams":50}}'
```
OpsBot: [NOTIFY] Primary ack: Marta V at 11:12. Secondary ack: Ethan L at 11:13. Infra-oncall paged at 11:15 should they be needed.
Priya S: Customer comm draft (one-line): "We observed elevated latency affecting streaming endpoints; mitigations applied and distribution restored. Further update in 30m. Incident 1765499999." LGTY?
Marta V: LGTY. Send now. Also logging timeline into incident tracker: https://internal.redwood/incidents/1765499999/timeline
Nate R: Handoff notes for next shift: primary->Ethan L until 16:00 UTC, secondary->Priya S. Outstanding actions: monitor gateway connection distribution, schedule gate-sync rollout for sticky routing behind feature flag, investigate why config didn't propagate (controller race). Escalation thresholds: errors>3% page secondary immediately; errors>6% page SRE lead and AMs.
Ethan L: I'll own the post-mortem and include a blameless root cause: config propagation race + lack of preflight gateway-sync. Proposed remediation: a gating check in CI to verify feature flag propagation to all gateway instances before rollout.
Priya S: Adding runbook pointer: sticky-routing preflight check -> https://internal.redwood/runbooks/sticky-preflight. Also put in a scheduled job to sample gateway configs every 5m for 24h.
OpsBot: [RESOLVE CHECK] 11:50 UTC  error rate sustained <1% for 20m. Incident state: mitigated. Awaiting human confirm for close.
Marta V: Confirm mitigated and keeping incident open for postmortem. Will hand over to Ethan at 16:00. Final note: follow escalation tree when customer impact rises: primary -> 1m -> secondary -> 5m -> infra -> 10m -> SRE manager. Use #emerg if cross-team urgent. Thanks team :party_parrot:
